summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of director Anders Karlsson from the board and Audit Committee effective November 1, 2026, stated not to result from any disagreement, and the appointment of existing independent director June Han to the Audit Committee effective the same date. The filing also elects home-country practice exemptions under Nasdaq Rule 5615(a)(3)(A) from annual meeting, proxy solicitation, shareholder approval, majority-independence and executive-session requirements, supported by a Harneys opinion. This is routine board succession and governance disclosure, not a forced departure event; no deal terms apply.
